name: Dream Kitchen
source:
After an unexpected meeting, mysteriously, a planned kitchen appeared in place of your old one. And somehow, her appliances and furniture are haunted by handsome men. Now you will need to live with them while trying to figure out what mess you are in. got in.
What awaits you is nothing less than a Dream Kitchen.

[From [URL=https://imaginovel.itch.io/dream-kitchen]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
一場意外的相遇之後，你原來的廚房神秘地變成了一間量身打造的整套系統廚房。不知為何，裡面的電器和傢俱竟都附著帥氣男子的靈魂。如今，你得一邊與他們共同生活，一邊弄清自己到底捲進了什麼麻煩。
等待你的，正是一間如夢似幻的廚房。

[摘自[URL=https://imaginovel.itch.io/dream-kitchen]itch.io[/URL]]
